card_text: A hard part for Roswell: a shaved line that suits a grown-up cut, timed to the event and the drive.

seo.title: Hard Part Haircut for Roswell, NM | Divinely Faded
seo.description: Hard part haircuts for Roswell, shaved in at my chair in Carlsbad, south on US 285. Who the line suits, booking it before an event, and the drive.

paragraphs: A hard part is a parting shaved into the scalp, so it holds without a comb from the moment you leave until the hair fills it back in. I shave them in Carlsbad, at {{address}}, {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles south of Roswell on {{city:roswell.route}}, a drive of about {{city:roswell.drive_min}} minutes (OpenStreetMap routing).

blocks.heading: Not only a young man's cut.
paragraphs: Roswell's median age is {{city:roswell.median_age}}, almost the same as Carlsbad's {{city:carlsbad.median_age}} (Census ACS 2023). I mention it because people assume a shaved part belongs to teenagers. On a side part or a comb-over, it does the opposite: it sharpens a classic cut without changing it, which is why it looks right on someone in their thirties or forties who wants the part to stay put through a workday.

Only {{city:roswell.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} of Roswell's workers are in mining, oil, gas or farming, against {{city:carlsbad.mining_ag_jobs_pct}} in Carlsbad (Census ACS 2023). If your week is desks, counters or classrooms, a single clean line over a low fade reads as tidy, not loud.

blocks.heading: Book the line close to the day.
paragraphs: A part shaved to skin is the first detail to vanish, because there's nothing to hide the stubble. If the line is for a wedding, a photo or an interview, get the cut within a few days of it rather than a few weeks. After the event, let it soften into the rest of the cut until your next trip down.

blocks.heading: The cut carries the line.
blocks.lead: Pick one; mention the part when you sit down.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: Fade, top and the shaved part, with a straight razor neckline to finish.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The same cut plus your beard, trimmed or lined up, and a hot towel. One drive, whole head done.

items.q: Does a hard part cost extra?
items.a: A simple part line is cut as part of the haircut. If you want it to turn into a design, text me a picture first and I'll tell you whether it's the hair design add-on, {{addon:hair-design}}.

items.q: Which side goes the line, if I've never had one?
items.a: The side your hair already falls toward. Fighting your natural part means fighting it every morning in Roswell, with me {{city:roswell.drive_mi}} miles away. The hard part page shows the placement on a real cut.

items.q: How long until the line is gone?
items.a: It depends on how fast your hair grows and how dark it is against your scalp. I'll give you my honest guess in the chair.
